title: Exolyt vs YouScan: TikTok-Native Social Listening Compared
summary: Exolyt is genuinely TikTok-exclusive. YouScan isn't. Compare pricing, platform coverage, ratings, and which tool actually fits a TikTok-only brand.
body_markdown:
"Exolyt vs YouScan" sounds like a fair fight between two TikTok tools. It isn't. Search either name and you'll find pricing pages, review sites, and roundups that treat them as interchangeable options in the same "TikTok analytics" bucket — but one of these tools was built exclusively around TikTok's data, and the other treats TikTok as one source among several.


That distinction matters more than a feature checklist. Pick a TikTok-exclusive tool when your brand actually lives across multiple platforms, and you're paying for depth you don't need while missing mentions everywhere else. Pick a broad multi-platform tool when your entire presence is TikTok, and you're paying for coverage you'll never use. Below is what each tool actually does, what it costs, and which one fits which brand — plus where a tool built for spoken, not just visual, mentions fits into the decision.


## How does Exolyt's pricing compare to YouScan's?


Exolyt starts lower on paper — free, then $400/month — but gates its most useful analysis features behind its top tier. YouScan starts higher at $499/month but bundles more by default, with its own pattern of billing advanced capabilities separately.


Exolyt's three tiers: a free Basic plan (1 account, 1 hashtag, 1 campaign, no listening projects), Essentials at $400/month ($330/month billed annually, 50 accounts/hashtags, 10 campaigns, 3 listening projects), and Advanced at $950/month ($790/month annually, 300 accounts/hashtags, 100 campaigns, 15 listening projects). Sentiment analysis and video transcription — the two most useful analytical features — only unlock at Advanced, a 2.4x jump from Essentials (Source:[Exolyt Pricing, 2026](https://exolyt.com/pricing) ). For a broader look at what teams outgrow Exolyt for, see our[Exolyt alternatives breakdown](https://syncly.app/blog/exolyt-alternatives-for) .


YouScan's Starter-3 plan runs $499/month and includes core visual recognition out of the gate. But reviewers on Capterra consistently flag a comparable gating pattern: image recognition, advanced dashboards, and API access get billed as separate add-ons rather than bundled into a single tier, so the real cost of a fully-equipped setup climbs past the advertised starting price (Source:[Capterra — YouScan Reviews](https://www.capterra.com/p/173036/YouScan/reviews/) ).


Neither vendor's list price tells the whole story. Both charge a premium for their most useful capabilities — Exolyt through a hard tier jump, YouScan through per-feature add-ons.


## What are Exolyt's and YouScan's core platform and feature differences?


Exolyt is a TikTok-exclusive analytics and campaign-tracking tool: account, hashtag, and sound tracking, influencer campaign analytics, and benchmarking, with no coverage outside TikTok at any tier. Per Exolyt's own reviewer, it "is not meant for paid media management or platforms outside TikTok," and it operates as an independent analytics layer rather than an official TikTok partner (Source:[ColdIQ — Exolyt Review, 2026](https://coldiq.com/tools/exolyt) ).


YouScan's core differentiator is different: AI-powered visual recognition — identifying brand logos, products, and scenes inside images and video content — plus Insights Copilot, a conversational AI agent for querying data in plain language. That visual AI runs across TikTok, X, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Reddit, and Threads, along with blogs, forums, review platforms, online news, and podcasts (Source:[The SI Lab — YouScan Vendor Directory, 2026](https://www.thesilab.com/tool/youscan) ). TikTok is one of roughly seven social sources YouScan monitors, not a specialty.


**TikTok-native social listening** : a social intelligence tool built exclusively around TikTok's data — accounts, hashtags, sounds, and campaigns — with no coverage of other platforms at any pricing tier, as distinct from broader[visual or cross-platform listening](https://syncly.app/blog/audio-vs-visual-social-listening) tools that include TikTok as one of several sources.


By that definition, Exolyt qualifies. YouScan doesn't — its own product marketing doesn't even name TikTok specifically, describing coverage of "thousands of media sources" generically rather than positioning itself as a TikTok specialist.

## Which one fits a TikTok-only brand vs a multi-platform visual-first brand?


The right answer depends on how concentrated your brand's mentions actually are — and that varies more by product category than most teams assume.


A brand running exclusively on TikTok, with no meaningful campaign or mention volume elsewhere, fits Exolyt: deep hashtag, sound, and campaign analytics on the one platform that matters, without paying for coverage you won't use. TikTok's pull in some categories makes this a real scenario, not a hypothetical — TikTok drives 53% of all skincare earned media value, more than Instagram and YouTube combined (Source:[WeArisma Beauty Influence Index via Influencer Marketing Hub, 2026](https://influencermarketinghub.com/tiktok-platform-for-beauty-influencer-marketing/) ).


But that concentration doesn't hold everywhere. In fragrance, the same dataset shows Instagram still beating TikTok in earned media value — $4.67 billion versus $2.36 billion (Source:[WeArisma Beauty Influence Index via Influencer Marketing Hub, 2026](https://influencermarketinghub.com/tiktok-platform-for-beauty-influencer-marketing/) ). Category determines platform concentration, not assumption. A brand with a visual-first presence spread across TikTok, Instagram, and elsewhere — where the goal is[catching a product shown on camera](https://syncly.app/social/feature/video-analysis) without being named — fits YouScan's cross-platform visual recognition better than a TikTok-only tool ever could.


There's a structural argument for looking past single-platform coverage entirely, regardless of category: the typical social media user is active across 6.75 different platforms per month, so relying on just one channel misses a real share of where mentions happen (Source:[Sprout Social — 120+ Social Media Marketing Statistics for 2026](https://sproutsocial.com/insights/social-media-statistics/) ). It's also worth noting that YouScan's model is built around monitoring the channels you point it at, while Syncly Social's[social listening](https://syncly.app/social/solution/social-listening) approach discovers relevant content by topic first — a difference that matters as much as raw platform count when a brand's mentions show up somewhere nobody thought to track.


Neither Exolyt nor YouScan covers the gap that matters most for brands whose mentions are spoken, not just shown, across short-video platforms — a creator who says a brand name out loud while holding an unbranded product, missed by hashtag tracking and by image recognition alike.[Syncly Social](https://syncly.app/social) is built around Audio Intelligence (transcribing what's said) and AI Vision (reading what's shown) together, catching[untagged mentions](https://syncly.app/social/feature/untagged-mentions) across 10+ platforms including TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts — not TikTok-exclusive like Exolyt, and not image-recognition-first like YouScan. For a deeper look at multi-platform video listening, see our[TikTok monitoring tools comparison](https://syncly.app/blog/tiktok-monitoring-tools-comparison) and how Syncly Social approaches[competitor analysis](https://syncly.app/social/solution/competitor-analysis) beyond a single platform.


## Key Takeaways


-


Exolyt is genuinely TikTok-exclusive at every pricing tier — the only tool of the two that actually earns the "TikTok-native" label.


-


YouScan covers TikTok as one of roughly seven social platforms (plus blogs, forums, news, and podcasts) — strong TikTok coverage, but not a TikTok-first identity.


-


Exolyt starts at $400/month but gates sentiment analysis and video transcription behind its $950/month Advanced tier, a 2.4x jump.


-


YouScan starts at $499/month and includes core visual recognition by default, though image recognition, dashboards, and API access are billed as separate add-ons per reviewer reports.


-


Platform concentration varies by category — TikTok drives 53% of skincare earned media value, but Instagram still leads in fragrance — so the "right" tool depends on where your brand's mentions actually live, not on assumption.


Exolyt and YouScan solve different problems dressed up as the same search query. If your brand is genuinely TikTok-only, Exolyt's depth is worth the tier-gating. If your presence spans TikTok and other visual platforms, YouScan's cross-platform recognition fits better than a TikTok specialist ever will. And if your mentions are spoken as often as they're shown, neither tool sees the full picture.
